beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley settles into the chair Dave just left.

options.text: Hey — what's going on?
Do I know you from somewhere?
You're late.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I got offered a spot on tour with this band. But I'd have to drop out of my program to do it. I don't know if that's brave or just stupid."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: The Fool's about a fresh start — one thing ending right as another begins.
It means you're throwing away everything you worked for.
This card isn't really about decisions like that.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't know, dropping out feels pretty reckless."

options.text: It's not reckless — it's standing at the edge, calm, not scared of the fall.
Reckless is exactly the right word for it.
The edge doesn't really mean anything here.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if the tour falls apart and I've got nothing to go back to?"

options.text: That's the risk this card's asking you to take — saying yes to the unknown, not playing it safe.
Then you'll have wasted your shot, and that's on you.
It won't fall apart if you don't think about it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't even know what happens after the tour ends."

options.text: You don't need that mapped out yet — the path shows up once you actually step onto it.
Then you're not ready to go at all.
What happens after doesn't matter.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "My parents think I'm ruining my life over this."

options.text: That reaction kind of proves the point — this card's energy is going against convention.
They're right, you should listen to them.
What your parents think isn't relevant to a reading.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Everyone in my program's been doing this way longer than me. I'd be starting over from nothing."

options.text: Starting over isn't weakness here — it's a beginner's mind, curious instead of guarded.
You should feel behind, because you are.
Experience doesn't come into this at all.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One more thing — the Fool travels light. Whatever you decide, taking it with a little levity beats carrying every worst case with you.
